blocks.x: One governed platform, many GenAI products — retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.

Enterprises that build GenAI apps ad hoc end up with a dozen disconnected stacks, inconsistent guardrails and no idea what inference costs. We build the alternative: a central GenAI platform providing model routing, managed retrieval, prompt and policy management, evaluation harnesses, red-teaming hooks, and per-team cost meters — so product teams ship in days on rails that risk teams already trust.

The platform is model-agnostic by design: frontier APIs, open-weight models served on vLLM, and fine-tuned specialists behind one gateway with semantic caching, fallback routing and PII redaction enforced at the edge. Every response carries provenance metadata, so audit can trace an answer to the document, the model version and the policy that allowed it.
